name: Dwarf_Warrior_Hall_Hex_V1
origin: center of footprint on ground Z=0
scale: Native 4X map units; pointy-top tile radius 1, military foundation radius .92; placement scale tile_radius. Asset only, no integration.
design: Original dwarf warrior hall: low broad granite barracks, transverse dark slate stepped roof and copper bindings, squat carved rune portal and prominent crossed double-headed axe/war hammer on blue clan cloth. Open right stone-post armory with slate lean-to and reserve axe/hammer; open wedge sparring court with two short slash-marked straw melee targets, stance markers, small repair anvil, bench and blue military standard. Palette matches dwarf city I and tank hall. Same shared warrior/swordsman/weapon-master line; supreme blade hero belongs to separate mastery building. No watchtower, shield-training equipment, surrounding wall ring or character-model dependency.
notes: Studio and scale reference excluded from export. Separate editable source parts; consolidated game meshes by architectural group.
faction_tint: Blue crossed-weapons backing cloth and military standard isolated in Faction mesh for future owner tint; slate, granite, copper and steel retain their palette. No runtime integration.
